_comment: Absolute device budgets from docs/PLAN.md §9, checked by tools/benchmark/compare_benchmarks.py --budgets (T-1803, T-1801). Keys are className.testName; the budgeted metrics are summed. Widget renders and map masks come from :benchmark:micro as timeNs medians. An entry with physicalDeviceOnly is checked only with --physical-device: the nightly job measures on an emulator, whose RSS is far above a phone's (ADR-0018 addendum). GlanceWidgetBenchmark has no budget: GlanceAppWidget.compose measures Glance's own session, a constant ~400 ms on CI whatever the widget draws, while §9's 30 ms render budget is what WidgetRenderBenchmark measures.

ir.taqvim.benchmark.micro.WidgetRenderBe.unit: ns (30 ms widget render, grid included)
